skills.description: This skill should be used when the user asks about drug/medication information, wants to look up drug instructions, side effects, dosage, indications, or needs a drug instruction manual link. Triggers include: user asks about a specific drug like '布洛芬怎么吃', '阿莫西林的副作用', '头孢的用法用量', '对乙酰氨基酚说明书', '这个药能和那个药一起吃吗'; or general drug queries like '退烧药有哪些', '消炎药推荐', '止痛药的注意事项'. Does NOT trigger for: symptom analysis or health diagnosis (use tencentcloud-adp-diagnosis instead), non-drug health questions ('我头疼怎么办' → use diagnosis skill), or drug purchasing/pricing questions.
